text.name: TextDesc2
text.text: DevilutionX is an open-source recreation of the engine used by the original Diablo released by Blizzard Entertainment in 1996. The project modernizes the classic action role-playing game while preserving its original gameplay, graphics, and atmosphere. It adds support for modern operating systems, higher resolutions, improved controls, bug fixes, multiplayer improvements, and quality-of-life enhancements while remaining compatible with the original game data. Diablo introduced many players to randomly generated dungeons, real-time combat, character classes, and loot-based progression that became foundations of the action RPG genre.
